search.question: Welche Vorteile und Grenzen haben Retrieval-Systeme?

hits.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Knowledge Work
hits.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation can ground generated answers in a changing knowledge base and expose supporting passages for enterprise knowledge work.
limitations: Answer quality depends on retrieval coverage and source freshness.
The system still needs evaluation for unsupported claims.

hits.title: Context Selection and Ranking in Long-Document Retrieval
hits.abstract: Adding more retrieved context does not always improve an answer; irrelevant or poorly ordered passages can distract a model, so selection and ranking remain important.
limitations: Long-document behavior can vary with context order.
Retrieval scores alone do not prove answer correctness.

question: Welche risk-, compliance- und privacy-Aspekte gelten für high stakes organizational search?

search.question: Welche risk-, compliance- und privacy-Aspekte gelten für high stakes organizational search?

hits.title: Human Review for High-Stakes Research Assistants
hits.abstract: Human review is useful for high-impact research decisions because automated systems may miss ambiguous evidence or outdated policies.
limitations: Review introduces operational cost and latency.
Reviewers need clear evidence and escalation criteria.

hits.title: Metadata and Access Control for Organizational Search
hits.abstract: Organizational retrieval needs metadata filters and permission checks; without them, relevant context can be excluded or unauthorized content can be exposed.
limitations: Permission metadata must remain synchronized with source systems.
Strict filters can reduce recall for legitimate users.
